acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrate one requirement supported by meaningful assertions in two test files, with immutable selectors and both paths retained after linking.
Define an explicit accumulate or replace contract and retain compatibility; repeated linking must never silently erase earlier multi-file support.
Keep re-extraction, exact requirement-ID checks, supported CEM bindings and semantic uncertainty intact; document structural linkage versus assertion coverage.
body: Observed during issue396 public integration using installed Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163. OCM LinkOptions has one TestPath; selectClaims enumerates only that blob. linkObligation in public base90161895 internal/lrfrepo/ocm_write.go:931 replaces the obligation claimIds and hunkIds with the new invocation. One PMM obligation has real reducer/CLI/Git assertions in different files, so issuing a second path cannot retain both claim sets. Expected: an explicit reviewed route can retain multiple actual immutable test-path assertion anchors for a single requirement. Actual: last path replaces prior supported claims; DOGFOOD_OCM_LINKS rows cannot represent full multi-file evidence. This is a confirmed capability limitation from implementation inspection, not a fabricated failing runtime result or assertion that replacement violates the present contract. Current workaround retains a one-path structural OCM subset plus a separate semantic assertion inventory/review and actual package checks; it makes no whole-obligation proof claim from that subset. Reproduction source: internal/lrfrepo/ocm_write.go754-771,900-932 at90161895. Local artifacts /private/tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/companions-396-integration-semantic-assertion-inventory.json and integration-semantic-preflight.md. Dedup OCMlink/multi-file/claimset searches found no existing owning item; V1-0275 tracks separate selector-normalization friction. Qualification remains unverified local runtime; no production change here.
title: OCM: retain explicit multi-file assertion links for one requirement
